newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales to total $731 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales to total $731 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $731 million in 22 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $457 million in 18 issues. The largest is a two-part $245.8 million Washington general obligation deal at 1130 EST.
Negotiated sales total $274 million in four offerings. The largest is a $345.7 million Houston refunding deal through senior manager PaineWebber Inc.
An additional $814 million of deals are on the possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may priced the deals Tuesday depending on market conditions.
